reasons: The initial primary-reference whitelist omitted current modelTests/independentRules/sharedProtocols report links and treated unknown paths as historical. V2 requires the current schema links and only narrowly identified legacy source fields receive retention classification.
V2 validates asset-map dictionary type, exact actual-APK key set and every SHA256 format/value; nonempty non-dictionaries cannot pass.
V2 requires nonempty typed checklists, positive counts and standard artifact-check keys; empty collections cannot pass vacuously.
Strict APK and gameplay video size limits remain below 10000000 bytes. No browser, model, signing or video-decode rerun was added.

tests.name: empty required artifact map cannot pass
unknown missing reference is not historical
recognized historical citation remains narrowly scoped

method.assetManifestCompared: Every actual APK asset, exact key set and SHA256 value, against signing/verification/gameplay and present browser asset maps
method.sourceCompared: Exactly three source files: actual APK game-model.js, game.js and shared renderer.js against published files AND progress.sourceCommit blobs
method.signatureScope: stored certificate/signature/source receipts checked against the exact independently hashed APK; no new certificate validation claim
method.referenceScope: Current schema report links are required even if their fields are missing. Only game-and-field-specific legacy descriptive citations receive historical-retention classification; unknown references must exist and otherwise fail. Explicit scratch/includedInRelease:false and hash-only originals are disclosed separately. Encoder frameManifest describes intermediate inputs. Old maintenance/previousReleases are not audited.

limitations: No physical TV or phone testing was performed; all current records explicitly report both false.
This audit confirms stored delivery facts and payload/evidence consistency, not a fresh playthrough, signature certification, video decode, or judgment of gameplay uniqueness.
Recorder frameManifest entries are intermediate JPEG inputs, not a promise to publish each JPEG. The video hash and retained manifest are checked; no frame-content decode was rerun.

Missing descriptive legacy citations are retained as historical-evidence-retention findings, separate from primary published report links. Missing originals cannot be reverified from embedded summaries.
Explicit scratch references and unmatched hash-only original-evidence claims are not falsely promoted to archived files; per-game records disclose them.
If publication advanced concurrently, this report covers its captured current releases through the requested number only.
